```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Amazon and its peoples are critical to the planet’s health.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The stakes regarding the Amazon grow sharper daily as forests and peoples are exterminated while greenhouse gas emission levels continue to rise.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If another fifth of the Amazon burns, a release of “a doomsday bomb of stored carbon” could occur.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Jair Bolsonaro has emboldened land grabbers and illegal miners through categorical attacks on Indigenous peoples’ and Afro-Brazilians’ constitutionally-guaranteed right to the land, as well as landless workers’ right to occupy lands that have fallen into disuse.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Wealthy and politically powerful interests, including publicly traded multinational corporations and agribusinesses, influence and coerce actions to exploit the land to its final depletion.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Large landowners are organizing “Burn Days,” igniting tracts of forest that have been cut down while intentionally allowing the flames to burn out of control.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Indigenous territories and areas under conservation have been frequent targets of attacks this year.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The number of fires breaking out so far this year represents an 82% jump compared to all of 2018.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Bolsonaro and his core allies make their intentions clear with open praise for brutal tactics as well as proposals such as a constitutional amendment allowing Indigenous lands to be appropriated by agribusiness and mining interests.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Bolsonaro and his core allies are open agents of white supremacy and settler colonialism.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
